verdict.rationale: Apple's docs cite 'legendary power efficiency' and up to 22 hours video streaming for M4 Pro laptops, giving some battery-life evidence, but M4 Pro ships only in MacBook Pro (fan-equipped) and desktop Macs, not in any fanless design — the low-power/fanless claim is unmet. Community comments also question whether Apple's efficiency comparisons are fair (comparing to M3 instead of M3 Pro), adding skepticism to the efficiency framing. Missing for 10: fanless/quiet product examples, independent battery-life benchmarks, and resolution of community doubts about efficiency comparison methodology.
